CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.
   B. Use Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The little.
   B. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   C. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
   A. Use Adam and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Adam and.
   D. Say Adam and has no place in daily life.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ.
   B. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.

11. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.
   B. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story:.
   C. Use Bible Story: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Story: has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.
   D. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
